injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Devin Carter
injuries.detail: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Coby White
injuries.detail: White (calf) is out for Monday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Kylan Boswell
injuries.detail: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

injuries.name: Patrick Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (groin) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.detail: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

injuries.name: Noa Essengue
injuries.detail: Essengue (head) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Cooper Flagg
injuries.detail: Flagg (shoulder) is questionable to play Monday against the Heat.

injuries.name: Naji Marshall
injuries.detail: Marshall (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.detail: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Caleb Martin
injuries.detail: Martin (thumb) is listed as doubtful for Monday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against San Antonio.

injuries.name: Cameron Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson (ankle) is doubtful to play Monday against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Spencer Jones
injuries.detail: Jones (hamstring) is out for Monday's matchup with the Warriors.

injuries.name: Alpha Diallo
injuries.detail: Diallo (wrist) is doubtful for Monday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Gui Santos
injuries.detail: Santos is questionable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left knee tendinitis.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.detail: Williams is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left lower back soreness.

injuries.name: Charles Bassey
injuries.detail: Bassey is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to right patellar tendinopathy.

injuries.name: Marcus Smart
injuries.detail: Smart (forearm) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.detail: Adams has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks due to a right soleus strain.

injuries.name: Ivica Zubac
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlisle said that X-rays on Zubac's sprained left ankle came back negative, but he's got some swelling and is unlikely to play Monday in Milwaukee, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Zach Edey
injuries.detail: Edey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Sacramento due to left ankle injury management.

injuries.name: Karim Lopez
injuries.detail: Lopez (knee) is out for Sunday's game in Sacramento.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams was stretchered off the floor during Sunday's game against the Clippers due to an apparent left ankle injury, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace (shoulder) will not return to Sunday's game against the Clippers, Rylan Stiles of SI.com  reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams won't return to Sunday's game against the Clippers due to right wrist soreness, Nick Crain of SLAM reports.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.detail: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Otega Oweh
injuries.detail: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: Oso Ighodaro
injuries.detail: Ighodaro (oblique) is doubtful for Monday's matchup with the Thunder, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: AJ Dybantsa
injuries.detail: Dybantsa (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hornets.
